Sample — this is how an urgent notice appears

An urgent announcement sits at the top of the page, above This Week, in the burgundy panel. It is meant for a weather cancellation, a last-minute change to the service schedule, or a death in the parish family. Set "urgent": true on an entry in data/parish-announcements.json to put a notice here.
